name: functions
description: Cloud Functions per Esoteric Circle (ponte FreeAstroAPI)

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test: tsc && node --test lib/cerchio.test.js lib/validate.test.js lib/cammino.test.js lib/scadenze.test.js lib/ricordi.test.js lib/sfocatura.test.js lib/lapidi.test.js
scripts.test:regole: tsc -p tsconfig.regole.json && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-esoteric-circle "node --test lib/regole.emulatore.js"
